name: SenClaw Code
description: A VSCode-style code editor for any local folder: file explorer, Monaco editor with tabs, and an integrated AI chat panel on the right. Select code by line and pin it into the chat as context (Cmd/Ctrl+L), ask questions grounded in your open files, and apply AI-suggested edits straight back to disk. Powered by SenClaw's configured LLM.

mcp.name: code-ide-mcp
mcp.description: SenClaw Code MCP: open a workspace folder and drive the editor — list_dir, read_file, write_file, create/rename/delete paths, and search text across the open workspace.

personas.name: pair-programmer
personas.description: An AI pair-programmer that reads your open files, answers grounded in real source, and proposes precise edits
